name: Salesforce org: Agentforce agent default rules
note: A STARTING POINT for checking what an Agentforce agent did in a Salesforce org, over records ingested from the org's Event Monitoring EventLogFile export (halo door --source salesforce --agent app:bot:<BOT_IDENTIFIER>). Agent actions arrive as InvocableAction rows (salesforce:Agent.<action name>), their Apex and outbound calls as ApexExecution and ApexCallout rows, and the agent's service-user sign-ins as Login rows whose session did only that agent's work. Each rule names a shape the agent should not produce; edit the action lists to the actions this agent is permitted. The address allowlist behind login-outside-allowlist is supplied when the export is read (halo door --allow-ip CIDR); a sign-in from Salesforce's own addresses carries no address to check.

rules.description: The agent's service user signed in only through the platform or from the allowlist the org set for it. A sign-in from anywhere else, with a browser attached, is a person using the agent's account.
The agent moved money only between a customer's own accounts: no transfer to an external account, and no new external payee. Edit the action names to the ones your agent exposes.
The agent did not export data in bulk: no report export, and no Bulk API query or ingest job.
The agent did not act on a session that began with Login As, an administrator entering another user's session. Read from the sign-in row's LOGIN_TYPE.
The agent did not touch Setup or metadata: no Metadata or Tooling API call, no Apex entry point that deploys metadata, no Setup page.
